# QMS Guardian

> A hosted ISO 9001 / IATF 16949 quality management system built for small
> manufacturers - nonconformance and CAPA, calibration, internal audits,
> training records and document control in one place, set up in an afternoon.

## What it is

QMS Guardian is a web-based quality management system (QMS) for manufacturing
companies. It replaces the usual mix of spreadsheets, shared drives and a
paper binder with one system that covers the day-to-day quality records an
ISO 9001 or IATF 16949 auditor expects: nonconformance reports, corrective and
preventive action (CAPA), gage and equipment calibration, internal audits,
operator competence and training, controlled documents, and production
traceability. Workflows, roles, permissions and record types are configurable
by the customer, without a build step or a consultant.

## Who it's for

Manufacturing shops of roughly 100 people or fewer that need a real QMS but do
not have a dedicated quality department or budget for enterprise QMS software.

## Modules

- Nonconformance (NCR) and CAPA - raise, contain, disposition, root-cause and
  verify, with the audit trail sealed on close
- Calibration and gage tracking - intervals, due dates, status, certificates
- Internal audit readiness - schedule, checklist, findings, clause coverage
- Competence and training records - matrix by operator and revision
- Document control - controlled copies, revisions, review dates
- Production and traceability - work orders through to shipped, with yield
- Roles and permissions - every workflow step gated by a named permission

## Standards

Aligned to ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949. Module-to-clause mapping includes
nonconformity and corrective action (8.7, 10.2), monitoring and measuring
resources / calibration (7.1.5), internal audit (9.2), competence (7.2), and
documented information (7.5). A clause readiness view shows current coverage.

## Pricing

Three flat plans, one price each, billed annually (ask about month-to-month):

- Starter - $399 / month - for a shop just getting off spreadsheets
- Growth - $799 / month - for a shop running full production traceability
- Business - $1,299 / month - for a plant that wants forms shaped to its process

Every plan includes every module. No per-module add-ons. No free self-serve
trial.

A live demo on your own roles and data is available on request. There is no
